name: Luma Yuzu-Cardamom
description: A sophisticated, lightly sweetened sparkling soda using real yuzu extract and real cardamom oil, bottled in a tall frosted glass bottle with a magnetic reseal cap. Luma Yuzu-Cardamom is the default 'nice drink' of Tier 3-4 social gatherings — dinner tables, corporate lunches, and upscale cafes.
flavor_profile: Bright, citrus-forward yuzu with aromatic cardamom warmth, very fine carbonation, a dry botanical finish that lingers cleanly
cultural_context: Luma bottles have become a social signal — seen on desks, in meeting rooms, at rooftop gatherings. The frosted glass and magnetic cap are designed to be visible and recognizable. Gifting a four-pack of Luma is a standard mid-tier courtesy gesture between colleagues. On the Gray Zone, empty Luma bottles are traded as containers because of their quality seals.
story_hooks: Luma's 'real yuzu extract' certification has been flagged by an independent lab — the last two production runs show synth-compound ratios inconsistent with their premium labeling, and someone is sitting on the report.
A Tier 2 black-market bottler is refilling empty Luma bottles with a convincing counterfeit and selling them at Tier 3 prices; the forgery is good enough that even some regulars can't tell.
A corporate negotiation hinges on a detail: one party brought Luma, one brought Tamarind Rush — and neither is willing to drink the other's choice first.
